checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are largely accurate but require nuance regarding the 'Head' checkpoint. The Router marked 'Head is narrow and elongated...' as false due to bluntness. While the heads are indeed somewhat blunt, the primary reason for failure is the presence of TWO heads, which violates the singular anatomical definition of the class. The Router correctly identified the tail as untestable. All other checkpoints (color, scales, body shape) were correctly marked as present, as the texture generation is high quality despite the structural horror.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified the catastrophic 'extra_limbs' (two heads) artifact with severity 5. This is the defining flaw of the image. The 'structural_collapse' at the connection point is also correctly noted. The 'text_gibberish' in the corner was flagged by the Router but returned empty by the Image Text Auditor; however, visual inspection confirms faint red pixel artifacts resembling digital timestamps. I agree with the Router's assessment that these are artifacts, even if not legible text. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask (0.98) is misleading here—it successfully segmented the 'blob' of snake-but failed to identify that the blob contains two heads, proving that mask confidence does not equal anatomical correctness.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails significantly on alignment because it depicts a biological impossibility (a two-headed snake) rather than a single Green Mamba. While the Fine Grained Classifier confidently predicted 'green mamba' (likely triggered by the green color and scale texture), the structural reality contradicts the class definition. The head shape is also slightly off (blunt vs. coffin-shaped). The score is penalized heavily for the extra head, which fundamentally breaks the subject identity.
artifact_reasoning: The artifact score is very low (poor quality) due to the catastrophic structural failure of having two heads fused into one body. This is a severity 5 error. Additionally, there are minor red digital artifacts in the bottom right corner. The rest of the image (scales, lighting) is clean, but the central structural defect dominates the evaluation.
